opportunities.name: Hotel search, price conversion, and email proposal
opportunities.description: Search Booking.com for a hotel in a destination for given dates, convert the hotel price from EUR into a target currency on Xe, then draft an email to a contact proposing the hotel.
steps: On Booking.com enter destination and check-in/check-out dates and search
Open the top hotel result and note its name and price
On Xe open Currency Converter, enter the EUR amount, choose the target currency, click Convert
Open mail compose, fill To with the contact's address
Write body with the hotel name, EUR price, converted amount, 'OK to book?'

instances.values: Frankfurt Nov 17-20, Vienna House, 818 EUR to USD, maria@example.com
Milan Dec 1-4, BB Hotels Aparthotel Visconti, 264 EUR to JPY, kenji@example.com
Amsterdam Jan 12-15, Jan Luyken, 577 EUR to GBP, aisha@example.com

opportunities.name: City weather and news heads-up email
opportunities.description: For a city, look up the 10-day weather forecast and search BBC for the city's strike news, then email a contact a summary with the weather and top headline.
steps: On the weather site search for the city and select it
Open the 10 Day forecast and note the day's high/low and conditions
On BBC open search and search '<city> strike'
Open the top article and note headline and date
Compose mail to contact with subject 'Heads-up: <city> on <day>'
Write body with weather and latest news

opportunities.name: Visa requirements and holidays note
opportunities.description: Look up a nationality's visa requirements for a destination on Wikipedia, check the destination's holidays on timeanddate, and save a summary note.
steps: Search Wikipedia for 'Visa requirements for <nationality> citizens'
Find the destination country row and note visa status and stay
On timeanddate open Holidays and find the destination country
Note holidays for the relevant month
Add a new note summarising visa and holidays
